companyInfo.Footnote: Incorporated in the U.S. and headquartered in Sweden. Its North American headquarters are in Auburn Hills, Mich. Market value as of March 31, 2026.

description: Swedish American manufacturer Autoliv is the largest supplier to the automotive industry of passive safety systems, which protect occupants when a crash has already occurred. According to its own estimates, its seat belts and airbags helps prevent 600,000 injuries and save 37,000 lives a year. In 2017, the company decided to break itself in half and float its new entity Veoneer onto the stock exchange via a spinoff. As a result, Autoliv is no longer in the business of providing active safety systems, which use electronics to mitigate or prevent accidents before they occur.

rankings.itemDescription: Autoliv develops, manufactures and markets protective systems, such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels, for major automotive manufacturers worldwide. It also makes mobility safety solutions, such as pedestrian protection, connected safety services and safety solutions for riders of powered two- wheelers.
